facts.fact: 男孩把 Clay 领进树林，她留在岛上；Clay 回头却没挥手——他不想让男孩知道岛上还有个女人
facts.anchor: Clay turns his head back to the island, to me, but he doesn’t wave.

facts.fact: 她独自咬下那颗桃，一颗不够
他带回一条面包：「上面有人，一个社群，在树里」
facts.anchor: There’s people, Ellie. A community, up in the trees.

facts.fact: 社区的问候被磨得极短：「Tide pull you wrong?」「Rain find you last eve?」
facts.anchor: “Tide pull you wrong?” one man asked

facts.fact: 她把手按在肚子上说她可能怀孕了；他说「I canna lose ye」
社区有七十三人，住在废弃高尔夫球场上
facts.anchor: There are seventy-three members of their community

facts.fact: 他们用石头与一条废弃的锚链把岛固定住
日落时出现绿闪；最后一句「Ye, Ellie, are my homeland.」
